Implementation complete. Here is the result report.

## Files created or changed

- `src/platform/paths.ts` (new) — state-root resolution, typed layout accessors, `ensureLayout()`, and typed failure classes.
- `tests/unit/paths.test.ts` (new) — 24 unit tests covering resolution order, tilde expansion, mode bits, traversal rejection, and unwritable roots.

No other tracked files were modified by this task. (`docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` shows as modified because the engine writes to it; I did not edit it, and `docs/artifacts/` was not touched.)

## Requirements satisfied

- **PRE-FR-01** — Resolves `EASY_HOST_HOME`, then `XDG_DATA_HOME/easy-host`, then `~/.local/share/easy-host`; creates `apps/`, `tools/`, `buildkit/` with `0700`; refuses an unwritable root as a prerequisite failure (exit code 2).
- **PRD-SP-05** — `appDir(name)` validates against `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$` before the name becomes a path, blocking traversal.
- **PRD-SP-01 (directory half)** — All created directories are `0700`; existing directories are never chmodded (PRD-SP-06).
- **PRD-NF-02** — Failures name the failed check, the reason, and carry a remediation line.
- **PRD-NF-07** — Tests use temporary directories, no Podman, no network, no root.

## Contract notes

- New interface: `Paths` (`root`, `appsDir`, `toolsDir`, `buildkitDir`, `appDir(name)`, `ensureLayout(): this`) plus `resolveStateRoot()` and `createPaths()`.
- New error contract consumed by the top-level mapper: `StateRootError` (`exitCode: 2`, `code: "STATE_ROOT_NOT_WRITABLE"`, `remediation`) and `InvalidAppNameError` (`exitCode: 1`, `code: "INVALID_APP_NAME"`). PRE-1.3 must honor a numeric `exitCode` property on thrown errors, because `src/cli/errors.ts` does not exist yet and was intentionally not created here.
- No command, flag, JSON field, config key, or file-mode change.

## Validation

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run typecheck` | Pass (exit 0) |
| `npm test -- tests/unit/paths.test.ts` | Pass — 24/24 tests |
| `npm test` | Pass — 27/27 tests across 2 files |
| `npm run lint` | Pass — 9 files checked, no errors |
| `npm run build` | Pass — emitted `dist/`; `node dist/cli/index.js` prints `0.1.0` |

Note: `node_modules` was absent in the sandbox, so `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` was run before validation (install only, no dependency changes).

## Default assumptions applied

- Empty `EASY_HOST_HOME`/`XDG_DATA_HOME` is treated as unset.
- Relative environment paths are resolved against the process CWD.
- Writability is checked on the nearest existing ancestor of the root; existing roots are not chmodded.
- `~user` (without a slash) is not expanded; only `~` and `~/...` are.
